result.summary: Found 1 issue: a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge displayed on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section displays a '-0%' discount badge in the top-left corner, which indicates a missing or zero-value promotion.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount percentage is 0% or null, or ensure the actual discount percentage is properly populated.
